newsitem.title: USA: Boeing gets $486 mln order from Jet Airways.
newsitem.headline: Boeing gets $486 mln order from Jet Airways.

text.p: Boeing Co's commercial airplane group on Wednesday said India's Jet Airways has agreed to order six next-generation 737-800 and four 737-400 jets in a deal worth about $486 million.
The agreement by the private airline is subject to approval of the Indian government.
The 737-400s would be delivered beginning in 1997, and the 737-800s would be delivered from 1998 through 2000.

"This is strategically an important sale in India because of the significant growth we forecast for the domestic Indian market," Boeing vice president for international sales Seddik Belyamani said in a statement.
Founded in 1992, Jet Airways operates a fleet of 12 Boeing 737s.
